decision.reason: not-allowed: အကျိုးသက်သာ-မျှဝေခြင်း 4.0 အပြည်ပြည်ဆိုင်ရာ

explanation: Burmese translation of a Creative Commons 4.0 license. The title and body name no English license, but its sharing term means ShareAlike or NonCommercial, and the section refuses both CC-BY-SA-4.0 and NC variants.
